mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP2D6; propafenone inhibits CYP2D6 and may significantly increase tolterodine levels, while tolterodine may also inhibit propafenone metabolism, increasing arrhythmia and anticholinergic toxicity risks.
action: Monitor closely for anticholinergic effects and cardiac arrhythmias; consider dose reduction of tolterodine or alternative antimuscarinergic agent; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
